description.text: The third Pokémon TCG Battle Academy, launched on 21 June 2024: three ready-to-play 60-card decks led by Armarouge ex, Pikachu ex and Darkrai ex, so two players can battle with Armarouge or Pikachu and then switch to Darkrai. It included new promo cards: four Mareep, three Flaaffy, two Ampharos, four Pawniard, three Bisharp, two Kingambit, a Miraidon and six Picnicker. A two-player game board, two tutorial guides, a rulebook, three deck boxes, a large metallic coin showing the three Pokémon, damage counters and a code card for Pokémon TCG Live came with it. This set holds the decks' reprints of Scarlet & Violet cards, which carry their deck's silhouette mark.
